headline: 每日深读｜2026-10-04：5项值得追踪的进展
lead: 本期从过去24小时的12项合格候选中，选取5项有来源的报道，按具体进展展开。

chapters.title: U.S. Navy Commissions Flight III Destroyer USS Ted Stevens (DDG 128) in Alaska
chapters.angle: 追踪本次报道中的具体变化

blocks.text: Navy has officially commissioned the USS Ted Stevens (DDG 128), its newest Flight III Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer equipped with the SPY-6 radar and Aegis Baseline 10, during a ceremony in Whittier, Alaska.

displayTranslation.text: 美国海军已在阿拉斯加惠蒂尔举行的仪式上正式将USS Ted Stevens（DDG 128）编入现役，这是其最新的Flight III型阿利·伯克级导弹驱逐舰，装备SPY-6雷达和Aegis Baseline 10。
displayTranslation.sourceText: Navy has officially commissioned the USS Ted Stevens (DDG 128), its newest Flight III Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer equipped with the SPY-6 radar and Aegis Baseline 10, during a ceremony in Whittier, Alaska.

blocks.text: US Navy press release The U.S. Navy placed its newest Flight III Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer, USS Ted Stevens (DDG 128), into active commission today during a formal ceremony in Whittier, Alaska.

displayTranslation.text: 美国海军新闻稿称，美国海军当天在阿拉斯加惠蒂尔的一场正式仪式上，将其最新的Flight III型阿利·伯克级导弹驱逐舰USS Ted Stevens（DDG 128）编入现役。
displayTranslation.sourceText: US Navy press release The U.S. Navy placed its newest Flight III Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer, USS Ted Stevens (DDG 128), into active commission today during a formal ceremony in Whittier, Alaska.

blocks.text: As the second Flight III destroyer to enter active service, USS Ted Stevens provides combatant commanders with unmatched integrated air and missile defense capabilities, directly supporting Department of War priorities to enforce maritime dominance, secure contested sea lanes, and project credible deterrence worldwide.

displayTranslation.text: 作为进入现役的第二艘Flight III型驱逐舰，USS Ted Stevens为作战指挥官提供一体化防空反导能力，直接支持美国国防部门关于实施海上主导、确保有争议海上通道安全以及在全球投射可信威慑的优先事项。
displayTranslation.sourceText: As the second Flight III destroyer to enter active service, USS Ted Stevens provides combatant commanders with unmatched integrated air and missile defense capabilities, directly supporting Department of War priorities to enforce maritime dominance, secure contested sea lanes, and project credible deterrence worldwide.

blocks.text: The commissioning of the USS Ted Stevens (DDG 128) underscores the Navy’s commitment to building America’s Golden Fleet. The commissioning of USS Ted Stevens marks an immediate, decisive leap in naval warfighting readiness and surface fleet lethality.

displayTranslation.text: 报道称，USS Ted Stevens（DDG 128）的服役彰显了海军打造美国“黄金舰队”的承诺；其服役标志着海军战备水平和水面舰队杀伤力的一次直接、决定性的跃升。
displayTranslation.sourceText: The commissioning of the USS Ted Stevens (DDG 128) underscores the Navy’s commitment to building America’s Golden Fleet. The commissioning of USS Ted Stevens marks an immediate, decisive leap in naval warfighting readiness and surface fleet lethality.

blocks.text: “To my crew, my shipmates, the men and women who are the heart and soul of this great ship, you have exceeded all expectations,” said U.S. Navy Capt. Mary Katey Hayes, commanding officer of USS Ted Stevens. “We are ready to answer our nation’s call.

displayTranslation.text: 美国海军上校Mary Katey Hayes是USS Ted Stevens的指挥官，她在引述中称全体舰员已经超出所有预期，并称军舰已准备好响应国家召唤。
displayTranslation.sourceText: “To my crew, my shipmates, the men and women who are the heart and soul of this great ship, you have exceeded all expectations,” said U.S. Navy Capt. Mary Katey Hayes, commanding officer of USS Ted Stevens. “We are ready to answer our nation’s call.

blocks.text: We are ready to defend freedom, whether the winds of war blow near the rugged coast of Alaska, or in the far reaches of the globe.”

displayTranslation.text: 她表示，无论战云出现在阿拉斯加崎岖海岸附近还是全球遥远地区，军舰都准备好捍卫自由。
displayTranslation.sourceText: We are ready to defend freedom, whether the winds of war blow near the rugged coast of Alaska, or in the far reaches of the globe.”

blocks.text: USS Ted Stevens is built around the AN/SPY-6(V)1 Air and Missile Defense Radar (AMDR) and Aegis Baseline 10 combat system, delivering a generational leap in simultaneous Anti-Air Warfare (AAW) and Ballistic Missile Defense (BMD).

displayTranslation.text: USS Ted Stevens以AN/SPY-6(V)1防空反导雷达（AMDR）和Aegis Baseline 10作战系统为核心构建，在同时进行防空战（AAW）和弹道导弹防御（BMD）方面实现了代际跨越。
displayTranslation.sourceText: USS Ted Stevens is built around the AN/SPY-6(V)1 Air and Missile Defense Radar (AMDR) and Aegis Baseline 10 combat system, delivering a generational leap in simultaneous Anti-Air Warfare (AAW) and Ballistic Missile Defense (BMD).

blocks.text: Featuring enhanced electrical power distribution and expanded cooling capacity, the destroyer is engineered to operate in high-threat environments and integrate seamlessly with joint and coalition forces.

displayTranslation.text: 该驱逐舰具备增强的电力分配和扩展的冷却能力，设计用于在高威胁环境中作战，并与联合部队和盟军力量无缝整合。
displayTranslation.sourceText: Featuring enhanced electrical power distribution and expanded cooling capacity, the destroyer is engineered to operate in high-threat environments and integrate seamlessly with joint and coalition forces.

blocks.text: For 250 years, American naval power has projected strength globally.

displayTranslation.text: 报道还称，250年来美国海军力量一直在全球投射实力。
displayTranslation.sourceText: For 250 years, American naval power has projected strength globally.

chapters.title: ESA to pursue crew transport and space stations as European launchers come online
chapters.angle: 追踪本次报道中的具体变化

blocks.text: Illustration of The Exploration Company’s Nyx capsule approaching the ISS. (Credit: The Exploration Company) European crew transport Preparing for the decommissioning of the International Space Station (ISS), currently scheduled to begin in 2030, ESA and other ISS partners are working to ensure sustained access to low-Earth orbit.

displayTranslation.text: 在欧洲载人运输方面，为准备国际空间站（ISS）退役——目前计划于2030年开始——ESA和其他ISS伙伴正努力确保对近地轨道的持续进入能力。
displayTranslation.sourceText: Illustration of The Exploration Company’s Nyx capsule approaching the ISS. (Credit: The Exploration Company) European crew transport Preparing for the decommissioning of the International Space Station (ISS), currently scheduled to begin in 2030, ESA and other ISS partners are working to ensure sustained access to low-Earth orbit.

blocks.text: Ultimately, ESA wants a European version of all capabilities required for human spaceflight, including not only rockets and a crew vehicle but also a launch abort system, space operations, science, and crew recovery.

displayTranslation.text: ESA最终希望拥有欧洲版本的人类航天所需全部能力，不仅包括火箭和载人飞船，还包括发射逃逸系统、空间操作、科学和乘组回收。
displayTranslation.sourceText: Ultimately, ESA wants a European version of all capabilities required for human spaceflight, including not only rockets and a crew vehicle but also a launch abort system, space operations, science, and crew recovery.

blocks.text: Artist’s impression of the LINCE crew capsule reentering Earth’s atmosphere. (Credit: PLD Space) With commercial interest in building European companies, ESA might follow NASA’s approach with its Commercial Crew Program, which supported the development of SpaceX’s Crew Dragon and Boeing’s Starliner.

displayTranslation.text: 在建设欧洲企业存在商业利益的背景下，ESA可能效仿NASA的商业乘组计划做法，该计划曾支持SpaceX的Crew Dragon和波音的Starliner的研制。
displayTranslation.sourceText: Artist’s impression of the LINCE crew capsule reentering Earth’s atmosphere. (Credit: PLD Space) With commercial interest in building European companies, ESA might follow NASA’s approach with its Commercial Crew Program, which supported the development of SpaceX’s Crew Dragon and Boeing’s Starliner.

blocks.text: Artist’s impression of a potential future European orbital outpost. (Credit: ESA) European space station With the ISS’s retirement in sight, ESA has initiated partnerships with companies working on commercial space stations.

displayTranslation.text: 在ISS退役临近之际，ESA已启动与从事商业空间站研制的公司的合作。
displayTranslation.sourceText: Artist’s impression of a potential future European orbital outpost. (Credit: ESA) European space station With the ISS’s retirement in sight, ESA has initiated partnerships with companies working on commercial space stations.

chapters.title: Northrop Grumman’s Talon Blue Collaborative Combat Aircraft Has Flown
chapters.angle: 追踪本次报道中的具体变化

blocks.text: We have a significant update on the fast-moving world of Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) out of Mojave, California today.

displayTranslation.text: 今天从加利福尼亚州莫哈韦传来了协同作战飞机（CCA）快速演进领域的一项重大更新。
displayTranslation.sourceText: We have a significant update on the fast-moving world of Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) out of Mojave, California today.

blocks.text: Northrop Grumman’s Talon Blue, which now has the official designation YFQ-48A, has taken to the skies for the first time.

displayTranslation.text: 诺斯罗普·格鲁曼的Talon Blue现已获得正式编号YFQ-48A，并首次升空。
displayTranslation.sourceText: Northrop Grumman’s Talon Blue, which now has the official designation YFQ-48A, has taken to the skies for the first time.

blocks.text: Talon Blue flying out of Mojave Air and Space Port for the first time. (@Task_Force23) TASK_FORCE23 The uncrewed aircraft took to the skies over Mojave Air and Space Port, home of famed ‘bleeding0edge’ airframer and Northrop Grumman subsidiary Scaled Composites, which built the aircraft.

displayTranslation.text: 这架无人飞行器在莫哈韦航空航天港上空首飞，该地是著名“前沿”航空制造商、诺斯罗普·格鲁曼子公司Scaled Composites的所在地，该子公司建造了这架飞机。
displayTranslation.sourceText: Talon Blue flying out of Mojave Air and Space Port for the first time. (@Task_Force23) TASK_FORCE23 The uncrewed aircraft took to the skies over Mojave Air and Space Port, home of famed ‘bleeding0edge’ airframer and Northrop Grumman subsidiary Scaled Composites, which built the aircraft.

blocks.text: A release from Northrop Grumman reads: “MOJAVE, Calif. – Oct. 3, 2026 – Northrop Grumman’s (NYSE: NOC) YFQ-48A Talon Blue completed its first fully autonomous flight, including taxi, takeoff, in-flight maneuvers, and landing.

displayTranslation.text: 诺斯罗普·格鲁曼发布的新闻稿称，该公司YFQ-48A Talon Blue于2026年10月3日完成了首次完全自主飞行，包括滑行、起飞、飞行中机动和着陆。
displayTranslation.sourceText: A release from Northrop Grumman reads: “MOJAVE, Calif. – Oct. 3, 2026 – Northrop Grumman’s (NYSE: NOC) YFQ-48A Talon Blue completed its first fully autonomous flight, including taxi, takeoff, in-flight maneuvers, and landing.

blocks.text: The flight builds on Northrop Grumman’s seven decades of autonomy experience and more than 500,000 autonomous flight hours, with lessons from Talon Blue informing future autonomous systems.

displayTranslation.text: 此次飞行建立在诺斯罗普·格鲁曼七十年自主技术经验和超过50万自主飞行小时的基础上，Talon Blue的经验将用于未来自主系统。
displayTranslation.sourceText: The flight builds on Northrop Grumman’s seven decades of autonomy experience and more than 500,000 autonomous flight hours, with lessons from Talon Blue informing future autonomous systems.

blocks.text: Details on YFQ-48A Talon Blue: Talon Blue is part of Northrop Grumman’s internally-funded Project Talon portfolio focused on accelerating the development of mission-ready autonomous airpower capabilities.

displayTranslation.text: Talon Blue属于诺斯罗普·格鲁曼自筹资金的Project Talon组合，该组合聚焦加速开发可执行任务的自主空中力量能力。
displayTranslation.sourceText: Details on YFQ-48A Talon Blue: Talon Blue is part of Northrop Grumman’s internally-funded Project Talon portfolio focused on accelerating the development of mission-ready autonomous airpower capabilities.

blocks.text: Every flight and lesson strengthens our broader autonomy work and sharpens what comes next.” Talon Blue flying above the Mojave Desert in California. (Northrop Grumman) While the Talon Blue aircraft draws most of the attention, Northrop Grumman has put great emphasis on its back-end autonomy development ecosystem, which includes its purpose-built Model 437 demonstrator aircraft , now under the Talon IQ badge (formerly Beacon).

displayTranslation.text: 报道称诺斯罗普·格鲁曼还高度重视其后台自主开发生态系统，其中包括专门建造的Model 437演示机，现归入Talon IQ品牌（原Beacon）。
displayTranslation.sourceText: Every flight and lesson strengthens our broader autonomy work and sharpens what comes next.” Talon Blue flying above the Mojave Desert in California. (Northrop Grumman) While the Talon Blue aircraft draws most of the attention, Northrop Grumman has put great emphasis on its back-end autonomy development ecosystem, which includes its purpose-built Model 437 demonstrator aircraft , now under the Talon IQ badge (formerly Beacon).

blocks.text: Talon Blue is entering a growing field of CCA offerings, with extremely intense competition, that are primarily aimed at equipping the USAF with its next CCA acquisition of hundreds of aircraft known as Increment 2 , for which the requirements remain undefined.

displayTranslation.text: Talon Blue正进入一个不断扩大的CCA候选机型领域，竞争极为激烈，这些机型主要旨在为美国空军下一次采购数百架飞机的CCA增量2计划提供装备，而该计划的需求仍未确定。
displayTranslation.sourceText: Talon Blue is entering a growing field of CCA offerings, with extremely intense competition, that are primarily aimed at equipping the USAF with its next CCA acquisition of hundreds of aircraft known as Increment 2 , for which the requirements remain undefined.

blocks.text: Many more types are on the horizon, including those from new players and globally from foreign manufacturers . (@Task_Force23) TASK_FORCE23 (@Task_Force23) TASK_FORCE23 With the loss of the F/A-XX next-generation naval fighter program to Boeing, Northrop Grumman winning a contract from the U.S. services for Talon Blue has become more important.

displayTranslation.text: 报道称，随着F/A-XX下一代海军战斗机项目被波音获得，诺斯罗普·格鲁曼为Talon Blue赢得美国军方合同变得更加重要。
displayTranslation.sourceText: Many more types are on the horizon, including those from new players and globally from foreign manufacturers . (@Task_Force23) TASK_FORCE23 (@Task_Force23) TASK_FORCE23 With the loss of the F/A-XX next-generation naval fighter program to Boeing, Northrop Grumman winning a contract from the U.S. services for Talon Blue has become more important.

chapters.title: Raytheon awarded $24.4 billion multi-year contract for SM-6 interceptors
chapters.angle: 追踪本次报道中的具体变化

blocks.text: Raytheon has secured a five-year contract, with two additional option years, valued up to $24.4 billion for Standard Missile-6 (SM-6) interceptors, significantly increasing the availability of a critical munition able to conduct both offensive strikes and missile defense missions.

displayTranslation.text: 雷神获得了一份为期五年、另有两个选择年的合同，用于标准导弹-6（SM-6）拦截弹，价值最高达244亿美元，将显著提高这种既能执行进攻打击又能执行导弹防御任务的关键弹药的可用性。
displayTranslation.sourceText: Raytheon has secured a five-year contract, with two additional option years, valued up to $24.4 billion for Standard Missile-6 (SM-6) interceptors, significantly increasing the availability of a critical munition able to conduct both offensive strikes and missile defense missions.

blocks.text: “SM-6’s multi-mission capability is vital to our customer, and Raytheon is intensely focused on meeting the demand,” said Raytheon President Phil Jasper.

displayTranslation.text: 雷神总裁Phil Jasper表示，SM-6的多任务能力对客户至关重要，雷神正高度专注于满足需求。
displayTranslation.sourceText: “SM-6’s multi-mission capability is vital to our customer, and Raytheon is intensely focused on meeting the demand,” said Raytheon President Phil Jasper.

blocks.text: “SM-6’s multi-mission capability is vital to our customer, and Raytheon is intensely focused on meeting the demand,” said Raytheon President Phil Jasper. “By continuously investing in our operations and facilities, we are removing constraints and boosting capacity to ensure we deliver this critical capability our sailors depend on.”

displayTranslation.text: 他补充说，通过持续投资于运营和设施，公司正在消除制约并提高产能，以确保交付水兵所依赖的这一关键能力。
displayTranslation.sourceText: “SM-6’s multi-mission capability is vital to our customer, and Raytheon is intensely focused on meeting the demand,” said Raytheon President Phil Jasper. “By continuously investing in our operations and facilities, we are removing constraints and boosting capacity to ensure we deliver this critical capability our sailors depend on.”

blocks.text: SM-6 is the only combat-proven weapon that can perform anti-air warfare, anti-surface warfare and ballistic missile defense.

displayTranslation.text: SM-6是唯一一种经过实战验证、能够执行防空战、反水面战和弹道导弹防御的武器。
displayTranslation.sourceText: SM-6 is the only combat-proven weapon that can perform anti-air warfare, anti-surface warfare and ballistic missile defense.

blocks.text: It has been successfully fired from various U.S. Navy ship-based platforms and launchers on land, providing the fleet with a versatile and highly reliable weapon to counter the full range of kinetic threats faced by today’s naval forces.

displayTranslation.text: 报道称，该导弹已成功从美国海军多种舰载平台和陆基发射装置上发射，为舰队提供了一种用途广泛且高度可靠的武器，用于应对当今海军力量面临的各类动能威胁。
displayTranslation.sourceText: It has been successfully fired from various U.S. Navy ship-based platforms and launchers on land, providing the fleet with a versatile and highly reliable weapon to counter the full range of kinetic threats faced by today’s naval forces.

chapters.title: Oct. 3, 1942: The V-2 successfully launches
chapters.angle: 追踪本次报道中的具体变化

blocks.text: A 12-ton rocket loaded with a 1-ton warhead, the V-2’s successful launch would prove to be exceptionally significant to both the military and to space exploration.

displayTranslation.text: 一枚重12吨、搭载1吨弹头的火箭，V-2的成功发射对军事和太空探索都具有极其重要的意义。
displayTranslation.sourceText: A 12-ton rocket loaded with a 1-ton warhead, the V-2’s successful launch would prove to be exceptionally significant to both the military and to space exploration.

blocks.text: On Oct. 3, 1942, the V-2 was fired from Peenemunde, Germany – its fourth test, and the first to succeed.

displayTranslation.text: 1942年10月3日，V-2从德国佩内明德发射，这是其第四次试验，也是第一次成功。
displayTranslation.sourceText: On Oct. 3, 1942, the V-2 was fired from Peenemunde, Germany – its fourth test, and the first to succeed.

blocks.text: The rocket rose to an altitude of 60 miles Continue reading "Oct. 3, 1942: The V-2 successfully launches"

displayTranslation.text: 该火箭升至60英里的高度。
displayTranslation.sourceText: The rocket rose to an altitude of 60 miles Continue reading "Oct. 3, 1942: The V-2 successfully launches"

events.excerpt: The U.S. Navy has officially commissioned the USS Ted Stevens (DDG 128), its newest Flight III Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer equipped with the SPY-6 radar and Aegis Baseline 10, during a ceremony in Whittier, Alaska. The U.S. Navy placed its newest Flight III Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer, USS Ted Stevens (DDG 128), into active commission today during a formal ceremony in Whittier, Alaska. The commissioning of USS Ted Stevens marks an immediate, decisive leap in naval warfighting readiness and surface fleet lethality.

evidenceRecords.text: Navy has officially commissioned the USS Ted Stevens (DDG 128), its newest Flight III Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer equipped with the SPY-6 radar and Aegis Baseline 10, during a ceremony in Whittier, Alaska.
US Navy press release The U.S.
Navy placed its newest Flight III Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer, USS Ted Stevens (DDG 128), into active commission today during a formal ceremony in Whittier, Alaska.

As the second Flight III destroyer to enter active service, USS Ted Stevens provides combatant commanders with unmatched integrated air and missile defense capabilities, directly supporting Department of War priorities to enforce maritime dominance, secure contested sea lanes, and project credible deterrence worldwide.
The commissioning of the USS Ted Stevens (DDG 128) underscores the Navy’s commitment to building America’s Golden Fleet.
The commissioning of USS Ted Stevens marks an immediate, decisive leap in naval warfighting readiness and surface fleet lethality.
“To my crew, my shipmates, the men and women who are the heart and soul of this great ship, you have exceeded all expectations,” said U.S.
Navy Capt.
Mary Katey Hayes, commanding officer of USS Ted Stevens. “We are ready to answer our nation’s call.
We are ready to defend freedom, whether the winds of war blow near the rugged coast of Alaska, or in the far reaches of the globe.”

USS Ted Stevens is built around the AN/SPY-6(V)1 Air and Missile Defense Radar (AMDR) and Aegis Baseline 10 combat system, delivering a generational leap in simultaneous Anti-Air Warfare (AAW) and Ballistic Missile Defense (BMD).

Featuring enhanced electrical power distribution and expanded cooling capacity, the destroyer is engineered to operate in high-threat environments and integrate seamlessly with joint and coalition forces.
For 250 years, American naval power has projected strength globally.

We are ready to defend freedom, whether the winds of war blow near the rugged coast of Alaska, or in the far reaches of the globe.” USS Ted Stevens is built around the AN/SPY-6(V)1 Air and Missile Defense Radar (AMDR) and Aegis Baseline 10 combat system, delivering a generational leap in simultaneous Anti-Air Warfare (AAW) and Ballistic Missile Defense (BMD).

events.originalTitle: Northrop Grumman’s Talon Blue Collaborative Combat Aircraft Has Flown
events.excerpt: We have a significant update on the fast-moving world of Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) out of Mojave, California today. Northrop Grumman’s Talon Blue, which now has the official designation YFQ-48A, has taken to the skies for the first time.

Talon Blue flying out of Mojave Air and Space Port for the first time. (@Task_Force23) TASK_FORCE23 The uncrewed aircraft took to the skies over Mojave Air and Space Port, home of famed ‘bleeding0edge’ airframer and Northrop Grumman subsidiary Scaled Composites, which built the aircraft.

A release from Northrop Grumman reads: “MOJAVE, Calif. – Oct. 3, 2026 – Northrop Grumman’s (NYSE: NOC) YFQ-48A Talon Blue completed its first fully autonomous flight, including taxi, takeoff, in-flight maneuvers, and landing.
The flight builds on Northrop Grumman’s seven decades of autonomy experience and more than 500,000 autonomous flight hours, with lessons from Talon Blue informing future autonomous systems.

Details on YFQ-48A Talon Blue: Talon Blue is part of Northrop Grumman’s internally-funded Project Talon portfolio focused on accelerating the development of mission-ready autonomous airpower capabilities.

Every flight and lesson strengthens our broader autonomy work and sharpens what comes next.” Talon Blue flying above the Mojave Desert in California. (Northrop Grumman) While the Talon Blue aircraft draws most of the attention, Northrop Grumman has put great emphasis on its back-end autonomy development ecosystem, which includes its purpose-built Model 437 demonstrator aircraft , now under the Talon IQ badge (formerly Beacon).

Talon Blue is entering a growing field of CCA offerings, with extremely intense competition, that are primarily aimed at equipping the USAF with its next CCA acquisition of hundreds of aircraft known as Increment 2 , for which the requirements remain undefined.

Many more types are on the horizon, including those from new players and globally from foreign manufacturers . events.excerpt: Raytheon has secured a five-year contract, with two additional option years, valued up to $24.4 billion for Standard Missile-6 (SM-6) interceptors, significantly increasing the availability of a critical munition able to conduct both offensive strikes and missile defense missions. “SM-6’s multi-mission capability is vital to our customer, and Raytheon is intensely focused on meeting the demand,” said Raytheon President Phil Jasper.

evidenceRecords.text: Raytheon has secured a five-year contract, with two additional option years, valued up to $24.4 billion for Standard Missile-6 (SM-6) interceptors, significantly increasing the availability of a critical munition able to conduct both offensive strikes and missile defense missions.
“SM-6’s multi-mission capability is vital to our customer, and Raytheon is intensely focused on meeting the demand,” said Raytheon President Phil Jasper.
SM-6 is the only combat-proven weapon that can perform anti-air warfare, anti-surface warfare and ballistic missile defense.

“SM-6’s multi-mission capability is vital to our customer, and Raytheon is intensely focused on meeting the demand,” said Raytheon President Phil Jasper. “By continuously investing in our operations and facilities, we are removing constraints and boosting capacity to ensure we deliver this critical capability our sailors depend on.”
It has been successfully fired from various U.S.
Navy ship-based platforms and launchers on land, providing the fleet with a versatile and highly reliable weapon to counter the full range of kinetic threats faced by today’s naval forces.

displayTranslation.summary: 雷神公司获得一份为期五年、另含两个选择权年的合同，价值最高达244亿美元，用于生产标准导弹-6（SM-6）拦截弹。该合同将显著提升这款关键弹药的可用性，它既能执行进攻性打击，也能执行导弹防御任务。雷神总裁菲尔·贾斯珀表示：“SM-6的多任务能力对我们的客户至关重要，雷神正全力聚焦于满足这一需求。”
